مَغْرِزٌ The place of growth, [or of insertion,]
(أَصْل,) of a feather, and the like, [such as a tooth, and also of the neck,] and of a rib, and of the udder; [of which last, and of the neck, and the like, it means the base, which is also termed اصل:] pl. مَغَارِزُ. (TA.) ―
-b2- [Hence,] The place in which the locust lays its eggs. (TA.) ―
-b3- [Hence also the saying,] اُطْلُبِ الخَيْرَ فِى مَغَارِزِهِ (tropical:) [Seek thou good in the persons in whom it is naturally implanted]; as also فى مَغَارِسِهِ. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
